messages:
Maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's multi-region game day — we observed a cascade where EU->us-west fallback pushed extra traffic to warm-standby and slowed restore windows. I'm listing concrete action items, owners, and rough ETAs. Please ack and update timelines inline.

Maria: Action items (short):
1) routing policy: add explicit weight caps + fallback circuit-breaker (owner: Jeff)
2) backup verification: add end-to-end verify job and alert on delayed increments (owner: Anya)
3) restore runbook: add step to flush prefix KV cache and run warm-standby throttle (owner: Tom)
4) canary rollback automation: ensure automatic fallback if latency spike > X ms for 2m (owner: Jeff)
5) game-day dry-run cadence: schedule monthly dry-run + tabletop + automated checklist (owner: Maria)

Jeff: I can take 1 & 4. For routing policy I'm drafting a change to the policy engine to set fallback weight <= 30% and a rate limiter circuit-breaker. Plan: PR by Mon EOD, deploy to staging Tue, smoke test Wed. Tagging Tom for runbook interplay.

Jeff: snippet of intended policy (staging):
```
route: {
  preferred_region: "eu-west-1",
  fallback_max_weight: 0.3,
  circuit_breaker: {window_s: 120, threshold_rps: 2000}
}
```

Anya: Taking #2. Confirmed incremental backups in eu-west had a 12m lag during the failover window. I'll add a verification job that runs post-snapshot and an alert (pager/ops) if lag > 5m. Aim: job + alert by Tue; test run Wed. Posting a small verify script below.

Anya: verify script (local test):
```bash
# check latest snapshot timestamp across regions
latest_ts=$(curl -s https://backups.internal/api/latest?region=eu-west-1 | jq -r .timestamp)
now=$(date -u +%s)
lag=$((now - latest_ts))
if [ $lag -gt 300 ]; then echo "ALERT: backup lag ${lag}s"; exit 2; fi
```

Tom: I will update the restore runbook for #3. Adding explicit step to flush prefix KV cache + a pre-restore warmup for warm-standby capacity checks. ETA: draft by Wed, review Thu. Need reviewers: Jeff + Anya. Also will add a short checklist for operators to run during game-day.

Tom: question — do we want the runbook to include the exact commands to switch route weights, or keep it high-level and rely on the automation?

Jeff: keep commands but mark them as emergency-only. Automation should handle normal failovers; manual commands in runbook with clear cautions. I'll add the admin CLI snippet to my PR.

sre-bot: Reminder: dry-run scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC — runbook v2 will be exercised in staging. Please RSVP in-thread.

Maria: RSVP please. We need 1 operator + 1 infra + 1 oncall for the exercise.

Jeff: +1 :thumbsup: available Thu 09:00 UTC

Anya: can do 09:00 but need a 30m prep window to warm up backup validation jobs

Tom: +1 will join for runbook execution and notes

Maria: Thanks all. I'll add this to the action-tracker and ping owners weekly until each item shows a PR/merge + test. I'll post PR links here as they land. Also scheduling the monthly tabletop for next month.

Maria: Quick next-steps (summary):
- Jeff: PR for routing + circuit-breaker (Mon EOD)
- Anya: backup verify job + alert (Tue)
- Tom: runbook draft + checklist (Wed)
- Everyone: join Thu 09:00 dry-run (sre-bot will remind)

Jeff: acked.

Anya: acked.

Tom: acked.

Maria: I'll follow up with a short 15m sync after dry-run to capture any emergency changes. Thanks!
